title: Aunt Carrie and Handsome Nephew, 1940s Family Vintage Photo
description: An intimate indoor portrait of an older woman, identified on the back as Aunt Carrie, seated alongside a young man. The woman wears a short-sleeved floral patterned day dress with a small brooch pinned at the neckline, her hair set in tight curls typical of the late 1930s and early 1940s. The young man beside her sports a swept-back pompadour hairstyle, a collared work shirt with flap pockets, and high-waisted pleated trousers held up with suspenders. The reverse side features black paper remnants from being mounted in an album and handwritten cursive identifying the subjects.
